title: A `richtext` value renders as a BLANK grid cell — the type is routed to MarkdownCellRenderer, whose pipeline drops the stored HTML
body:
Found while measuring objectui#5415 (record-grid row heights); a different defect class, filed separately and not fixed there.

## Measured

Real browser (Chromium, `apps/console` vite dev, `ObjectGrid` with inline data and a mock `getObjectSchema`). One row, one column, the stored value is the showcase seed's own richtext specimen (`examples/app-showcase/src/data/seed/index.ts`, `f_richtext`):

value stored: `p`-wrapped `Rich ` + `strong`-wrapped `text`

| column field type | cell `textContent` | cell inner HTML |
|---|---|---|
| `richtext` | **`""` (empty)** | `div.prose` … **empty** |
| `html` | `Rich text` | `div.prose` containing the real `p` / `strong` markup |
| `markdown` (control, markdown-shaped input `**bold** and _em_`) | `bold and em` | rendered markup |

So a populated `richtext` field shows the user **nothing at all** in a grid cell. Neighbouring `html` — same stored bytes, different declared type — renders it correctly, which is what rules out "the value never arrived".

## Mechanism

`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, `getCellRenderer`'s standard map:

```
markdown: MarkdownCellRenderer,
html:     HtmlCellRenderer,
richtext: MarkdownCellRenderer,   <-- here
```

`richtext` stores HTML (that is what `RichTextField` writes, and what the showcase seed carries), but it is dispatched to the **markdown** renderer, which hands the string to the sanitizing GFM pipeline (`MarkdownContent`). Raw HTML is dropped there, and since the value is *entirely* HTML, everything is dropped and the cell renders empty. The `title` attribute on the shared cell wrapper still carries the raw string, so the value is reachable on hover — which is why this reads as a styling nit rather than data loss until you look at the cell body.

`HtmlCellRenderer` already exists two functions below and handles exactly this shape (it sanitizes with `sanitizeHtml` and keeps the markup).

## Why it matters

Failure direction is the bad one: no error, no fallback, no console warning — a populated field reads as an empty field. Anyone auditing data through a grid concludes the records are blank.

## Note

Do not "fix" this by making the markdown pipeline pass raw HTML through — that would change every `markdown` cell's trust boundary. The question is which renderer `richtext` should map to, and that is a one-line decision in the map above (plus whatever the read side of the detail page does with the same type — not checked here).

Repro harness was untracked and removed; it is ~40 lines of `ObjectGrid` with `data: { provider: 'value', items }` plus a `getObjectSchema` stub, following the existing `apps/console/src/dev/DevRowActions.tsx` pattern.
